correctness.rationale: The full proof is reconstructed from the two-to-one Hensel parameterization for odd coordinate sums, separation of odd/even input parity at even sums, explicit square-fiber congruence in each even-sum subcase, and 8^3=512 lifts in the fully even case. The exact square-collision identity follows by odd-unit square counts and the j-to-j-2 recursion. Base cases and algebraic solution of E_k=(k+6)4^k+512E_{k-4} are verified. Direct integer enumeration checks every k=1..11 and all three strata for k>=5, but the all-k conclusion rests on the algebraic proof. Fourier normalization is the N^-2 average over N^2 characters.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A dyadic cubic moment cannot imply the quartic monomial moment because the supports do not determine one another under an additive automorphism of the ambient two-dimensional ring. Three-moment stabilization concerns pairs on a larger curve with three coordinates, and its energy counts different equalities. Odd-prime-square chirp ambiguity is a different operator invariant. The existing field quartic result does not apply to 2-adic rings. No stronger cited result was found that entails the displayed four-residue formula.

value.rationale: The quartic two-coordinate frequency graph is a motivated lacunary curve in discrete polynomial restriction. The exact global fourth moment is canonical and its four-adic recurrence produces a non-obvious residue-four oscillation and normalized growth of order N^(1/4), in sharp qualitative contrast with analogous finite-field quartic energies of order N^2. This is an exact family-wide harmonic invariant, not an arbitrary small computational slice; it does not purport to solve the weighted extension norm.
